purpose: Dataset provenance for a source-only GitHub repository; original data are retained locally.
checksum_policy: Existing manifest hashes are copied, not recomputed for the full datasets. The PLINK panel and retained model/KG were hashed during this audit. Blank hashes mean unverified, not checksum success.

record.source: Novogene Europe public NGS demo datasets

record.attribution: This analysis uses the Human Phenotype Ontology and HGNC; see source versions and licenses.
record.association_scope: HPO gene-disease mappings with source-specific OMIM/ORPHA IDs; not ClinGen clinical-validity or mechanism curation.

integrity.check: Official file inventory, per-member sizes and all internal gzip CRCs
Complete gzip stream including CRC, tar directory and expected component paths

record.scope: Original public archives and GWAS data downloaded and verified; source archives preserved.

reproduction_gaps: The GSE159677 processed H5AD, scDRS scores and custom trait weights are not GEO source files. A public project artifact URL is not yet available; the trait/GWAS and weight-generation provenance remain unconfirmed.

The PLINK panel is project-derived, not directly downloadable as ref_1000g_pruned.*. A rebuild must preserve marker identities and sample order for model.pt; checksums and small label tables are included.
The official gsMap resource URL returned HTTP 403 from this host during this audit; an author-supported accessible download endpoint must be confirmed.
The live OMIM mim2gene.txt is 990333 bytes; the installed snapshot is 990092 bytes. The existing lock is not silently updated; exact old-snapshot reacquisition is unconfirmed.

http_checks.name: gsmap_resource
http_checks.note: Official documentation lists this public URL; the current host could not access it during the audit.

publication_changes.portability: PopGen operational VCF/labels/build/training paths now default to repository-local data and can be overridden with POPGEN_1000G_VCF_DIR, POPGEN_SAMPLES_INFO and PANEL_TMP. Environment setup checks software separately from reference data. Algorithms and existing source locks were not changed.
publication_changes.readme: Root README documents repository download, features, installation, public data, conditional fourth-stage inputs, CLI and local web UI.
